ED_Title: Participation of non-governmental organizations, civil society organizations, academic institutions and the private sector, people of African descent and Indigenous Peoples’ representatives and institutions in the high-level meeting of the General Assembly to commemorate the twenty-fifth anniversary of the adoption of the Durban Declaration and Programme of Action
ED_DecisionText:
At its 114th plenary meeting, on 4 September 2026, the General Assembly, on the proposal of its President, (Footnote: A/80/L.116.) recalling paragraph 5 of its resolution 80/299 of 28 July 2026, entitled “Scope, modalities, format and organization of the high-level meeting of the General Assembly to commemorate the twenty-fifth anniversary of the adoption of the Durban Declaration and Programme of Action”, decided to approve the participation of non-governmental organizations, civil society organizations, academic institutions and the private sector, people of African descent and Indigenous Peoples’ representatives and institutions as listed in the annex to the present decision in the high-level meeting of the General Assembly to commemorate the twenty-fifth anniversary of the adoption of the Durban Declaration and Programme of Action, to be held pursuant to resolution 80/299.
